toy.title: Toy instance from the September tag-up
toy.knowledge: We have two DCs. A has capacity 130 and B has lost capacity, down to 50. S1 and S4 are priority stores: serve at least 90% of realized demand. Every store gets at least 60% of its forecast. Shortfall costs 20 per unit at priority stores and 10 elsewhere.

storm.title: Gulf storm week (M5-shaped network)
storm.knowledge: We run three distribution centers, one per state. Each normally ships only to its own state’s stores; cross-state shipments cost about four times as much. During a storm, FOODS at Texas stores is priority: serve at least 90% of actual demand. Every store gets at least 60% of its forecast in every category. If the state declares an emergency, the Texas FOODS floor drops to 80%. Shortfall costs 8 per unit on priority items and 6 elsewhere. The Texas rule counts as met only if all three Texas stores meet it.
